invariants.rationale: Method always returns the result of HoodieListPairData.eager, which should not be null.
The method returns an empty HoodiePairData by construction via Collections.emptyList().
Result is constructed directly by HoodieListPairData.eager.
As result is created from an emptyList, its count is zero.
Collecting the data as a list yields an empty list because the source was empty.
